run.name: JetBlue Airways Corporation
run.title: CP-OS host session (JBLU)
run.summary: JetBlue is a weak, liquidity-dependent credit: earnings do not cover debt service, but USD 2,226 million of liquidity and modest maturities through 2027 give time. Fare recapture of fuel costs decides the outcome. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is JETBLUE AIRWAYS CORP.

revenue.basis: Total operating revenues, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: EBITDA, computed (operating loss plus D&A), as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt 8,393 at September 30, 2026; LTM EBITDA excluding special items 149 (FY2025 plus nine months 2026 less nine months 2025); net debt uses 1,626. Unadjusted LTM EBITDA is 115, which would give higher ratios. Restricted cash of 264 is excluded.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM EBITDA excluding special items 149 divided by LTM cash interest paid, net 493 (427 plus 372 less 306). The nine-month cash flow line carries the same label but the interim filing does not repeat the net-of-interest-income wording.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash is 1,258 plus current investment securities 251 plus non-current investment securities 117. Undrawn is the Citibank revolver of 600, no balance outstanding. The Morgan Stanley line of up to approximately 200 is excluded because availability varies with pledged securities. No letters of credit are drawn on the revolver; the letters of credit disclosed are cash-collateralised in restricted cash.

cashflow.basis: Net cash (used in) provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Covenant levels, debt agreements and ratings are not supplied, so headroom and legal terms cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: The issuer reports no EBITDA, so every leverage and cover ratio rests on our own definition.
